gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-questrial: Capture It stands tall and almost sealed, its strokes uniform and urban. Questrial lets the page breathe beside it, its open sans shapes loosening what the heading clamps shut.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-sulphur-point: Capture It is urban and commanding, its letters nearly sealed. Sulphur Point opens every gap wide, in a marker-like line with bulky lowercase that keeps the loud heading company.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-t: Raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase that grabs the eye first. Capture Smallz hits hardest as the heading, while Noto Sans Tamil Supplement does its best work in round, parenthesis-like forms and a stocky middle band.
gen-dafont-college-gf-aldrich: Heavy, confident curves that never thin out, with big open counters. College leads the heading while Aldrich, a sans-serif, traces a cupped single thick thread through lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mozilla-text: Heavy-handed and authoritative, College makes every bowl match its stems. Mozilla Text brings tall bodies and flared terminals beside it, so the two feel like a shout and a conversation.
gen-dafont-college-gf-nata-sans: College hammers out thick curves and big counters in a tall lowercase, dynamic and authoritative from the first glance. College makes the statement; Nata Sans keeps the line steady with wide-mouthed curves.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuk: Dense, dynamic and loud, every stroke drawn like one thick thread. College is the one to make a statement, while Noto Sans Bhaiksuki does the reading with swollen lowercase and open apertures.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Clean, wide-mouthed Conthrax runs the heading, its lowercase so tall the capitals barely rise above it. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lets open counters breathe, its clipped ascenders keeping things tidy.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-old-hun: Noto Sans Old Hungarian opens its counters wide, even at tiny sizes. Conthrax takes the heading, geometric and clean, its tall bodies leaving capitals barely taller than the lowercase beside them.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-old-tur: Geometric to the core, Conthrax gives a wide mouth to its lowercase a. Noto Sans Old Turkic brings open-mouthed curves that stay clear, plus chunky, tall bodies next to the stricter heading.
